about-us.meta_description: Hiring the right people is important for every business, but managing recruitment alongside daily business operations is not always easy.
about-us.content_html:
Who We Are

Hiring the right people is important for every business, but managing recruitment alongside daily business operations is not always easy.

At HireHR Services, we help organisations meet their hiring needs through:

  • Internal and client-driven recruitment support
  • Flexible hiring solutions for businesses of all sizes
  • Support for both ongoing and project-based requirements

How We Work : Beyond CV Sourcing

We believe recruitment is more than finding resumes. It's about finding candidates who are genuinely suitable for the job.

Our recruitment process covers:

  1. Understanding the job requirements
  2. Sourcing relevant candidates
  3. Initial screening and evaluation
  4. Technical and functional assessment
  5. Candidate suitability and interest validation
  6. Interview coordination and feedback
  7. Offer management and joining follow-up

Our focus: Better-matched profiles, fewer avoidable rejections and less time spent by clients on screening.

What We Believe In

We believe good recruitment partnerships are built through trust, transparency and consistent delivery.

  • Quality over quantity in candidate submissions
  • Clear communication and timely follow-ups
  • Flexible solutions at competitive costs
  • A genuine commitment to client requirements

We welcome an opportunity to understand your hiring needs and show how HireHR Services can support your business.

HireHR Services: The Right Talent. The Right Approach.

permanent-hiring-solutions.meta_description: Employers need permanent hiring solutions to make sure candidates match both the requirements of the role and the cultural requirements of the organization.
permanent-hiring-solutions.content_html:
Employers need permanent hiring solutions to make sure candidates match both the requirements of the role and the cultural requirements of the organization. In an ever-growing business world, it is very important to have the right resource on your team. But finding the right candidate for a permanent job is a tiresome process. Everything from reviewing resumes to identifying the right candidate can prove time-consuming and potentially costly.

This is where HireHR can help your business find the right candidate. We provide permanent hiring services to our clients according to their niche requirements. Our talented team of experts and suitable technology support your search across multiple industries, so that you get the right candidate. HireHR solves your recruitment need by sourcing and enrolling the best candidates, the ones with the potential to become permanent assets for your organization.

contract-hiring-solutions.meta_description: Do you have short-term or long-term projects?
contract-hiring-solutions.content_html:
Do you have short-term or long-term projects? Are you planning to hire employees on a contract basis? We can provide resources for short-term or long-term employment. Contract staffing lets you hire employees you might otherwise have to lay off during the next downturn. We effectively assess and develop skills, keeping our associates ahead of the curve, so they can get the job done on a regular basis.

Contract staffing can help you in several ways: increased productivity, timely placement of resources, no additional compensation or unemployment costs, reduced overtime costs, lower overall costs, and less paperwork and HR involvement.

contract-to-hire-solutions.meta_description: This contractual staffing solution enables you to hire professionals who have proven their ability to be part of your team.
contract-to-hire-solutions.content_html: This contractual staffing solution enables you to hire professionals who have proven their ability to be part of your team. They demonstrate a good work ethic, fit your company culture and will continue to add value as your business grows.

recruitment-process-outsourcing.meta_description: RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) is a commonly outsourced service.
recruitment-process-outsourcing.content_html:
RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) is a commonly outsourced service. It is when an employer transfers all or part of its recruitment processes to an external service provider. This is where HireHR comes to your help. We release you from the burden of managing processes outside your core capabilities, while providing you with top talent. Lately, RPO firms have become immensely popular in India, and companies are choosing to use them to save time and gain monetary benefits in the long run.

At HireHR, we provide RPO solutions with all the necessary skills, tools and technologies for the recruitment process. Our dedicated team of recruiters will work onsite as well as offshore and address your recruitment challenges. We can assist you with campus hiring and bulk hiring as well.

our-specialty.meta_description: We can help you find suitable IT profiles for your internal hiring and for your clients.
our-specialty.content_html:
IT Hiring Service

We can help you find suitable IT profiles for your internal hiring and for your clients. Whether you need Java or .Net, or newer skills like Cloud, AI and ML, we have ready resources for most IT skills.

ITES Hiring Service

We can help you find the right candidates for your BPO and KPO divisions. We have expertise in bulk hiring and campus hiring in the ITES recruitment field.

Non-IT Hiring Service

If you need help hiring non-IT profiles, we can help you there too. We assist with non-IT hiring from support staff to management level (CEO/Director).

career-advice.meta_description: If you are a job seeker, it is important that you first know yourself better and find out what kind of job you would love to do.
career-advice.content_html: If you are a job seeker, it is important that you first know yourself better and find out what kind of job you would love to do. Do not define a better job by better pay alone. A job is not all about the pay. Whether you are looking for your first job or planning to switch jobs, HireHR can guide you towards a promising future.

job-seekers.meta_description: Do you lack confidence before a job interview?
job-seekers.content_html:
Interview Grooming

Do you lack confidence before a job interview? Are you uncomfortable with communication? Please reach out to us. We can surely guide you to come out of your comfort zone and become successful in the job market.

Resume Guidelines

They say the first impression is the last impression. A resume is the first thing employers look at when you apply for a job, so it is very important to format it properly. We at HireHR can guide you to prepare a suitable resume according to your level of experience and qualification.
